text:
Essen’s median asking rent stands at 9.7 €/m² in June 2026, up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 26.1 % over the last five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 8.5 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.15 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs 582 € per month, representing a rent‑burden of 13.5 % for two residents.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.6 % and an average of 32  days on market; 21 % of listings are let within a week, indicating moderate tightness. Asking rents sit 44 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 6.72 €/m².

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.24 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 9.97 – 10.38 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % rise.
